correctness.rationale: The exact four-eigenspace decomposition gives every transition-entry formula. The across-petal kernel has a globally positive quadratic factor; scalar RK4 values are strictly positive by a sum-of-squares identity; the rho-reflection identity and unimodality bound all within-petal differences. Hub-leaf transitions are (1-r(nh))/n and reverse sign exactly once at rho/n; the largest eigenvalue is n. The verified symbolic program checks the critical identities and 691 exact matrix polynomial entries across 15 graphs, but finite tests are corroborative only.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The generic SSP guarantee h<=1/(n-1) on these hub networks is strictly weaker than rho/n, since rho(n-1)>n for n>=3. Full scalar spectral stability alone normally cannot imply nonnegative entries; this graph-dependent equivalence does not follow from generic SSP. The unavailable full text leaves a residual possibility of stronger coverage.

value.rationale: The exact sharp n-only positive step replaces a matrix nonnegativity check for arbitrary numbers and sizes of clique petals in a natural hub-community diffusion family. It establishes positivity=spectral stability on irregular triangular networks not covered by prior exact classes, identifies all sharp failures at hub-leaf entries, and gives a strict forward-Euler step improvement approaching the stability radius factor rho; this is not a parameter relabeling.
